posts.text: OpenAI Employee Arrested Over Hidden Recording Device. An OpenAI employee has been arrested and accused of planting a hidden recording device inside an executive conference room at the company’s San Francisco offices. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz discusses the FBI investigation, how the inexpensive device was discovered and OpenAI’s response. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Modal CEO: AI Has Entered a ‘New Era of Software’. AI cloud startup Modal has raised $750 million at a $15.75 billion post-money valuation as demand surges for the infrastructure needed to build and run AI applications. CEO Erik Bernhardsson discusses the company’s more than 3 billion AI sandboxes, growing demand for inference and reinforcement learning, and why increasingly capable agents will need secure virtual environments where they can execute code and eventually take on longer-running tasks. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.text: AI Boom Drives ASML Higher as Nvidia Bets on Europe. Plus, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announces plans to invest an additional $2 billion in European deals. And, an inside look at the making of Grand Theft Auto VI, expected to be the biggest video game blockbuster of all time. (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.author: kimmonismus
posts.text:
Jensen Huang: We are witnessing the emergence of a new industrial revolution driven by AI. Massive investments have been made, and highly valuable startups have sprung up. 

Jensen repeatedly emphasizes the need to proceed safely and carefully; however, he views AI safety as an engineering challenge. Given the immense opportunities, we should move forward with cautious optimism rather than slowing down.

I couldn’t agree more. Accelerate! To quote Demis Hassabis: a golden era of scientific discovery right infront of us!

(Ps I love Jensens humor)

posts.author: SemiAnalysis_
posts.text:
COOL & INSIGHTFUL: "Idle compaction" was added to Claude Code TUI in their most recent release (2.1.299).

Each Claude Code session (with at least 200k+ context) will now automatically compact after being idle for ~54 minutes, in order to refresh the 1-hour TTL and prevent the user from incurring the cost of uncached input.

This will save end users a lot of money! Although, with the way Anthropic investor day is going, maybe they should roll this change back? 🤔
